ruling.recommended_action: Close case: no off-route segment and no unpublished charge; fare was metered on RydeTAXI and rider-directed stop is not chargeable beyond the meter.

rejected_claims.reason: The only routing event was the rider's own requested stop at Paya Lebar Square (chat 12:20:55, accepted 12:21:25) and the GPS trace follows the quoted route with no off-route segment; under RD-3(a) a rider-named stop is not a deviation, so RD-2 yields no refundable extra_km.

RydeTAXI is metered (fare.pricing = 'metered', quoted_total = null); the meter total of $40.62 comprises only metered distance/time, the published $1.47 platform fee and $1.04 of metered waiting time, none of which is an unpublished or non-qualifying add-on under FARE-1/RD-3(c).
